history.summary: A freehold 2BR (iResidences, D12 Novena-fringe) at $1.98M / $2,020 psf — ~3% above the $1,961 URA median and a near-$2M ticket for a 980 sqft 2BR. Decent Novena-belt fundamentals but the above-median entry, $1,000+/sqft premium pricing, and a thin 14-txn data base leave little upside margin.
history.rating_rationale: $2,020 psf is ~3% over the $1,961 URA median — a premium, not a discount — and $1.98M is a very high quantum for a 2BR, which thins the resale pool. The 4.8% CAGR is from only 14 txns (unreliable) and the score (568, off-frontier, losing arena record 191-207) signals it is fully to over-priced. Freehold and 710m to Novena are positives but do not justify paying above median for a small 2BR.
red_flags: ~$2M quantum for a 2BR — narrow resale pool
PSF ~3% above URA median — no value cushion
Off-frontier with a losing arena record (191-207)
catalysts: Freehold in the Novena medical/CBD-fringe belt
Novena healthcare hub supports stable tenant demand
